submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole is a retrospective unigram detector: it fires when the current token is a member of a fixed set of content-word tokens (e.g. must, shall, stared, glanced, princess, queen, violin, glucose, apple, pinch), with strength set by the token's embedding alone, and stays near zero on function words, punctuation, common near-synonyms (will, can, saw, looked, person, woman, water, guitar) and subword continuations (ist, ons, phony). The same token fires across carriers and is unaffected by words after it, while same-slot synonyms of different lexical identity silence it.
